answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake bonded to a unique verifiable work history before it can transact. A new identity starts in a quiet meadow of low limits and earns higher limits only after completing checked work over weeks, so one operator cannot spin up thousands of trusted copies overnight. The stake acts like quartz in concrete: cheap for one honest agent, but forging an army means locking real capital per copy and losing it if any copy cheats, which makes a Sybil flood at a busy wharf of trade uneconomic.
